Vanta 1.x alerts use `kind` instead of the required `tone` input. The inputs below come from the archived snapshot in `vanta-ui-v1`, and [`VantaAlertComponent`](/docs/v/1/reference/generated/vanta-alert-component) opens the 1.x reference, never the current one.

:::code vanta-alert.component.ts (1.x)

```ts
export class VantaAlertComponent {
  /** Visual intent of the 1.x alert; defaults to `info`. */
  readonly kind = input<'info' | 'warning' | 'danger'>('info');
  /** Short heading shown above the message. */
  readonly heading = input('');
  /** Emits when the reader closes the alert. */
  readonly closed = output<void>();
}
```

[View source](https://example.invalid/vanta/blob/v1.9.0/vanta-ui-v1/src/vanta-alert.component.ts#L14-L21)
